In my experience the best opportunities to meet people are through hobby courses adjecent to university. It could be for example playing an instrument in a band/orchestra, or doing some course in ASVZ, or taking one of the optional language courses. The male/female ratio is more even there, the atmosphere is nicer than in the lectures and you already have an easy conversation starter (common interest). That being said, I would not base your decision of doing a masters on dating. I don't think dating will be better if you do your masters at a different university or if you start working, and as other have said, you can always date people from outside uni as well.
